\documentclass{ximera}
\usepackage{ximera-select-all}

\title{ximera-select-all fixture}
\author{Phase 0}

\begin{document}
\begin{abstract}
Fixture for the \texttt{ximera-select-all} spec. Two problems, each with multiple correct choices, to exercise set-equality correctness. Selecting a strict subset MUST NOT complete; selecting any wrong-plus-any-right MUST NOT complete; only the exact correct set completes.
\end{abstract}

\maketitle

\begin{problem}
  Which of the following are prime numbers?
  \begin{selectAll}
    \choice[correct]{2}
    \choice{4}
    \choice[correct]{5}
    \choice[correct]{7}
    \choice{9}
  \end{selectAll}
\end{problem}

\begin{problem}
  Which of these functions are continuous on all of $\mathbb{R}$?
  \begin{selectAll}
    \choice[correct]{$f(x) = x^2$}
    \choice{$f(x) = 1/x$}
    \choice[correct]{$f(x) = \sin(x)$}
    \choice{$f(x) = \lfloor x \rfloor$}
  \end{selectAll}
\end{problem}

\end{document}
